articles.originalTitle: GTA 6 Just Can't Stop Breaking Records It Seems
articles.originalSummary: Sets new soundtrack streaming record on Spotify. Not content with being the biggest entertainment launch in history and the highest rated game of all time , GTA 6 has already broken another record. The game’s official album, which features all-new tracks from the likes of Dua Lipa , set a new opening day record for a soundtrack on Spotify with a dizzying 29.85 million streams. Read the full article on pushsquare.com
